title: Oracle host tape slots
statement: For natural numbers $m$ and $c$ with $c>0$, define a map from four slot indices to the host tape indices for parameters $m$ and $c$. The four selected indices are the source-bank positions indexed by $m$ and $m+1$, the final host tape index, and the call-bank position associated with virtual host $0$.
caveat: The definitions of the source-bank and call-bank index constructions are not included, so their selected positions cannot be described more explicitly.
